name: What Remains: Migizi
source:
In a world overrun by the undead and raiders and so many groups that are fighting each other for power, What Remains: Migizi puts you in the shoes of the main character, a guy haunted by a troubled past. As he struggles to leave behind the pain of his childhood and the mistakes he made growing up in the this ruined world, he must navigate a brutal apocalyptic landscape, face the remnants of humanity, and fight to become a better person in a world that demands the worst of everyone in order to survive.
Survival, redemption, and the fragile hope of rebuilding in this gripping story-driven kinetic visual novel.
